_readme: Reference paintings that become sprites (scripts/importSprites.mjs). Each entry: name (the atlas sprite it replaces), src, w/h (footprint in tiles), targetWidth (default (w+h)*16+2), colors, glow {minLum, warm} or false, white (background key), anchor {ax, ay} hand-set after --check, checked: true once judged by eye. islands: 'keep' keeps painted clouds and loose smoke (default: only the largest island survives).
